blocked_candidates.reason: Only-pharmacies claim omits existing exceptions and announced limited OTC retail expansion from January 2027. No universal ban card published.

verification_sources.findings: Ordinary waiting period, 300-day maximum, income-related allowance and medical evidence. Age rule has 2008-or-earlier transition; no exceptionless age card.
Adult disability allowance eligibility is not a universal 16–64 age interval; impact, assistance and pension status matter.
National pension exports to EU/EEA/Switzerland/UK stopped February 2025.
Residence and repeated temporary stays require assessment; old one-year pension rule not reproduced.
Under 65, significant functional difficulty, public-healthcare rehabilitation plan; the rehabilitation is free.
Ordinary EEA/Northern Ireland carriage one year, post three months; other-country carriage three months and postal prohibition. Controlled medicines have stricter rules.
Patientombud replaced patientombudsman from January 2024; advice supports complaints and rights.
Patient advisers guide claims rather than decide clinical errors or compensation.
2025 disability law prioritises supported individual living and participation. Institutions are not an automatic consequence of diagnosis.
Treatment relationship and lawful need govern access; exceptions to separate disclosure consent include same provider and emergencies.
Official municipal information on free voluntary programme, previous vaccine records and asylum/pregnancy access. No claim excluding adult basic protection.
Rehabilitative psychotherapy supports threatened work/study ability with clinical and other eligibility criteria.
Partial early pension is 25 or 50 percent, cohort-dependent age and no duty to reduce working time.
Conditional income-loss benefit for participation in under-sixteen care; rehabilitation allowance may be an alternative, not automatic.
Involuntary care requires statutory illness, danger/treatment need and unsuitable alternatives; minor rules differ.
Additional administrative safeguards for involuntary medication apply since April 2024.
Communicate interpreting needs to the provider; language assistance supports understanding care.
Clinician must explain condition and care options in a comprehensible way.
Patient rights apply to public and private providers; equal treatment does not imply identical entitlement or treatment.
Qualifying prior decisions underpin disability-card eligibility; disability label alone is not enough.
Community housing differs from round-the-clock assisted living; fees depend on service and delivery arrangement.
Other authorities arrange interpreting under their own duties; FPA is not the sole provider for every setting.
Limited OTC sales outside pharmacies scheduled for January 2027; universal pharmacy-only source rule not published.
Crisis conversation is confidential and anonymous. No opening hours, languages or phone numbers tested.
AA provides voluntary peer support concerning alcohol problems, rather than statutory clinical care.
Al-Anon provides peer support to relatives of people with alcohol problems.
FGM and honour-related violence can cause lasting physical and psychological harm; care questions avoid guaranteed outcomes.
Undocumented children and pregnant people retain care rights; card directs to clinical/entitlement assessment without blanket fee guarantee.
Informal-care support and child disability-benefit application routes; eligibility is individually assessed.

other_source_issues.reason: Uses current patientombud title; old source title is preserved only in source.
Card explicitly says after entitlement; not every permanent impairment automatically grants a card.
Card uses actual free rehabilitation/public-plan requirements rather than source partial-cost phrasing.
National pension question tests residence conditions; work-based accrual is kept separate.
Earnings-related pension is not a personal contribution savings balance; question uses insured earnings and accrual history.
Foreign pensions require each country's qualifying conditions; all-country automatic accrual is not asserted.
Card tests strict statutory conditions and medical decisions, not family preference or generic distress.
Round-the-clock staffing is limited to heldygnsomsorg, not every housing form.
Two-month deadline remains source context for allowance duration, not independently tested.
Age is contextual eligibility; transitional under-eighteen cases are not excluded by a card.
Parent/support-person participation retained as contextual source, but interpreting card tests adult language assistance only.
